thread:
Marco: Kuiper lab kit ETA Tue morning. They want an NDA signed, access creds, and a 2-day bench window. Who owns the NDA + bench plan? @Riley @Sasha
Riley: I have the NDA template. I'll share the link and the signer contact. Also need partner PO for shipping.
Sasha: For bench, propose focused matrix: throughput (tokens/s) at seq {128,512,1024}, p50+p99 latency, memory/OOM runs, quantized vs fp16. We'll run 3 replicates.
Samir: Rack requirements from Kuiper: dual 32A circuits, 2U chassis footprint. Can infra accommodate? cc: @Tia for KMS / data path.
Tia: From compliance: we need the signed NDA before we plug into any internal network. KMS/HSM access will require a service ticket. Suggest isolated VPC in lab and no customer data.
Elaine: Marketing check — do we have an embargo window? Kuiper asked for coordinated announcement if bench looks good. Not committing until legal clears NDA.
Marco: Good. Riley, can you get signer by EOD? Sasha, I'll carve 16h lab slot Fri-Sat for bench runs. Samir, can you confirm circuits by tomorrow?
Riley: Sent NDA link to kuiper-legal@kuiper.io. Added signer = 'Jordan Park (Kuiper)'. ping when they sign.
hw-bot: Calendar invite created: 'Kuiper bench window — Redwood lab' Fri 09:00-17:00. Link: https://cal.redwood.com/event/abcdef
Sasha: Test harness notes — use infra branch `kuiper-integ` then run: ```./bench_runner --model redwood/llama-3-small --seq 1024 --batch 8 --reps 3 --report-json ./kuiper/report.json``` We'll need GPU affinity pinned.
Samir: Rack OK but need lab ops to install PDUs. I've filed ops ticket #2439. ETA hardware power on Thu evening.
Tia: Ticket #WH-432 for KMS provisioning; follow-up with security review. No network access until compliance signs off.
Elaine: If NDA allows co-announcement, draft comms plan: embargo + joint blog + benchmarks summary. I'll prep two templates: one conservative, one celebratory.
Marco: Any risk of model variant mismatch? If Kuiper runs quantized weights, ensure we have compatible runtime. @Sasha
Sasha: We'll build quantized flavor ahead of time. If they send weights, ensure checksum and signed transfer. Also record perf with and without KV caching.
Riley: Kuiper signed the NDA at 1745130500. They uploaded the SN for the kit and will ship tomorrow morning.
Marco: Great. Update lab ops and security. I'll post final bench plan by EOD.
Elaine: FYI partner marketing lead is 'Nadia Chen' — I'll intro after legal confirms timing. :party_parrot:
Marco: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for the run. Ping here for any blockers.
